scripts.cloudflare:types: wrangler types workers/app/worker-configuration.d.ts --env-file workers/app/.dev.vars.example --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.audiobooks:types: cd workers/audiobooks && wrangler types --env-file .dev.vars.example --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.types:generate: npm run cloudflare:types && npm run audiobooks:types
scripts.test:workers:build: cd workers/audiobooks && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.local.jsonc --env-file .dev.vars.example --outdir reports/audiobooks-build

scripts.format: prettier --write src shared workers/app/src workers/audiobooks/src workers/audiobooks/*.test.ts koreader/tests tests scripts *.config.ts .github && stylua koreader/marginalia.koplugin koreader/tests --verify
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src shared workers/app/src workers/audiobooks/src workers/audiobooks/*.test.ts koreader/tests tests scripts *.config.ts .github && stylua --check koreader/marginalia.koplugin koreader/tests
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && knip --no-progress && jscpd && node scripts/quality.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-flags.mjs

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
